items.title: Winard Harper interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 10, 2014
items.q: Jackie brought my brother and I to the University of Hartford and we went to school there for a minute. So Jackie, I took a history class with him

ctx.x: And you got into the balafon over the years. What prompted that?

Different work experiences. I spent a little time with Jackie McLean, kind of, so I spent some time with Jackie McLean in the very early 80’s when I first came out of D.C., Jackie brought my brother and I to the University of Hartford and we went to school there for a minute. So Jackie, I took a history class with him where we studied some of the African music, you know, the roots of jazz. So it got me into thinking about a lot of African traditions. Then when I got to New York and I started to work with Betty…
